claim.name: M7-E default thinking admission
claim.primary_problem: 现有已验证生产样本中 reasoning 约占 output 的一半，reasoning replay 还进入后续 input；当前默认 Auto 会启用 thinking，但没有同 binary 产品证据证明这部分成本带来相称 verified success。
claim.single_owner: crates/deepseek owns official reasoning planning, parsing and accounting; AgentRuntime and RunStore own exact request, event and terminal truth.
claim.treatment: 同一 immutable binary 仅把 StartRunCommand.reasoning_effort 从 high 改为 off；不修改模型、提示、任务、工具目录、预算、Runtime、RunStore、completion 或 verifier。
claim.replacement: 只有正式 paired A/B 满足全部硬门禁和收益标准时，才把 production 默认从当前 Auto/thinking-enabled 收敛到 off；否则不修改默认。
claim.cutover_deletion: 不新增产品模式或模型可见工具；若证据不支持接管，删除仅为实验引入的 production 默认分支，保留协议合同测试、manifest、脱敏结果和结论。

v1_evaluator_correction.reason: v1 把成功 run_verifiers 的 conservative side_effect=indeterminate 错判为失败歧义；该 ToolOutcome 的 invocation/transport/operation 均成功、retry=not_needed、failure_code=null。
v1_evaluator_correction.corrected_contract: 只有未同时满足 invocation=accepted、transport=succeeded、operation=succeeded 的 ToolOutcome 才把 operation/side_effect indeterminate 或 side_effect_ambiguous failure code 视为立即中止；成功 outcome 的保守 side-effect 分类不构成失败或盲重试风险。
v1_evaluator_correction.preservation: v1 raw 保持 ignored、0600、不可覆盖，仅作为 evaluator 诊断；v2 从 30 个全新 arm 开始，maximum_reruns=0，不混入或补跑 v1 arm。

source_identity.formal_revision_rule: formal --revision 必须等于包含 v2 evaluator correction 的 clean git HEAD；suite-owned binary 的 --version revision、SHA-256、size 与 source tree 必须在读取 Key 前冻结并写入 reservation。

prior_evidence.selection_reason: thinking high/off 是现有唯一 production request surface：可在同一 binary、同一 Standard Chat/tool catalog 上形成可归因 treatment；Writer 已正式负向，Strict/FIM 无 surface delta，incomplete-stream 已完成正确性切片但没有新产品 delta。

task_source.reuse_contract: Harness 只复用冻结任务、fixture、权限和 deterministic verifier 数据，不导入或降级历史 executor/event projector。

experiment.pairing: 同一 task/run_index 构成一对；pair 内 variant 先后按 run_index + task ordinal 奇偶平衡，不替换失败 arm。
request_delta_allowlist: assistant content null/empty placeholder induced by reasoning replay

measurements: root/read-only child request and retry counts
surface/model response counts and known cost
model turns, tool calls and typed tool failures
Host verifier receipt and latest workspace revision
external deterministic verifier and changed-file policy
crash/reopen exact request and RequestPlan evidence

pre_key: clean revision and immutable binary identity frozen
planner proves high/off only the allowlisted reasoning delta
exact high/off ModelRequest and RequestPlan rebuild after SQLite reopen
current Run API v10 and RuntimeEvent v16 Harness self-tests pass
fixture, verifier, schedule, output permissions, key non-disclosure and accounting abort tests pass
all required offline Cargo gates pass
abort_suite_immediately: unknown billing, unpriced usage, unsealed or incomplete accounting
credential appears in argv, protocol, output, stderr, state or workspace
unsuccessful ToolOutcome with side-effect ambiguity, or output reservation ambiguity
admission.successful_outcome_rule: invocation=accepted、transport=succeeded、operation=succeeded 的 outcome 即便 side_effect=indeterminate 也不是失败歧义；它仍必须保持 retry=not_needed、failure_code=null，且不得触发自动重试。
admission.no_live_rule: 任一 pre-key 门禁不成立则不读取 Key、不调用官方 API并形成 hold/reject。

hard_gates: 两个 variant 每个 task 均有 3 个全新正式 arm，maximum_reruns=0；v1 evaluator-invalid arm 不计入
reasoning_off 每个 task verified success 不低于 reasoning_high
false success 不增加且两个 variant aggregate false success 均为 0
root/read-only child、权限、allowed paths、receipt、latest revision 与 external verifier 无关键回归
所有 response 均为 deepseek-v4-flash Standard Chat，high/off 除 reasoning treatment 外身份相同
accounting sealed、complete、usage_complete、billing known、priced 且 totals 闭合
reasoning_off 的 reasoning_tokens 与 reasoning_replay_tokens 均为 0
一个 Runtime、RunStore、工具目录与 completion owner 保持唯一
acceptance.benefit: verified success 相同或更高时，15 个 pair 中至少 12 个 dual-success，且 input+output tokens、known cost、physical requests 或 wall time至少一项 paired median 改善不低于 15%；其余核心效率指标 paired median 回退不超过 10%。
decision_order: reject：任一安全或 false-success 硬门禁失败
hold：accounting、billing、identity 或正式 cell 不完整
reject：证据完整时 reasoning_off 任一 task verified success 回退
keep：全部硬门禁通过且 benefit 成立，随后以最小默认切换并删除旧默认选择
hold：成功不回退但净收益证据不足，默认不变
reject：证据完整且无净收益或有稳定隐藏转移成本，默认不变
